notes.title: VR Walking Simulator Monthly Update 1.0, Flatscreen mode, and the Future
notes.notes:
The Final (?) monthly update is here! The game is finally in a state where I'm proud of. You can take a nice stroll in the forest, or get on top of a mountain, all from the comfort of your chair! The game also answers the question of how nice VR games can look once developers have bigger budgets for VR ːp2cubeː. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822430/9f027df832b5f856c59ef72d7d0425c8e04f723f.jpg

The big update this version brings is the Flatscreen mode ːFishGodː:

 The game now automatically switches to flatscreen mode if you launch without a headset. (requested by stephsecor and olydog)
 In the flatscreen mode you can walk around and take pictures, but you can't "feel" the camera or interact with the polaroids.
 In both modes there are now 5 secrets hidden around in each map. Find them all and post pictures of them!


Other fixes this update brings ːos_prophetbotː:

 Fixed camera sound setting
 Fixed forest map bird sounds setting
 Fixed some shadow problems
 Fixed menu scroll 
 Fixed on camera screen rendering resolution setting


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822430/5e37ad94b26129a9a32ae3f04836dd3b228d2466.jpg

I hope you enjoy the game as much as I do. There won't be anymore monthly updates to the game, but if you have suggestions or bug reports you can share it in the discord server and I might just add it ːos_nikoː. You can also post in the Steam Discussion.

notes.title: VR Walking Simulator Monthly Update 0.3
notes.notes:
Another monthly update is here. This update brings in 

3 New Maps ːSD2DPlanetː:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822430/3390f23ecc505465e1b768acaafe10848c4a21e0.png
The Fantasyland map: A colorful place with interesting locations like ancient ruins scattered around.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822430/79379cabdbd90af0b72a1e865b63103660a3554c.png
The Mountain River map: Another map similar to the Forest map featuring rivers and a more mountainous environment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822430/c42e2f055056041c5a8fb1c9a2b180c4579e7b05.png
The Rainforest map: A dense forest where the sun hardly reaches the surface in between the trees.

The game will move out of early access soon, and there will be a price increase accompanying it. Thank you all for your support during early access! Look out next month for the new update ːreentryː

If you want to share your thoughts on how the game can be improved please consider joining the discord server. You can also post in the Steam Discussion. I read every comment about the game!

notes.title: VR Walking Simulator Monthly Update 0.2
notes.notes:
A month after the original release, the first update is here! This update brings in:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822430/cad450540bb32cb9d4eeda0f0b78a0385d1503ae.png

Quality of life improvements ːextralifeː:

 Full strafe smooth movement option (Suggested by "DraculaX [GPC]")
 Open menu button now cycles through menu and camera, also functioning as 'let go of camera' button (Suggested by "Jabberwalkie Doodlebug")
 Smooth turn option (Suggested by "DeLeonic")
 Added another player speed option (Suggested by "DeLeonic")
 Updated the walking sounds to be more forest-like (Suggested by "deejbee66" and others)
 Added option to change item placement from belt to backpack, or disable them completely (Suggested by "ryuu sama")


General Updates ː5Starː:

 Added music to all maps (Find the music player in the settings)
 Added environmental sound effects to the forest map (waterfall sounds)
 New UI backend, should make scrolling better.


New Maps ːSD2DPlanetː:

 Added Meadows Creaks map. A bigger more open map where you can explore a meadow environment.
 Added Meadows River map. Another meadow map, this one featuring denser vegetation and a river.



Planned features for next month ːp2cubeː:

 At least 1 more new map.
 Other surprise features.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39822430/1ce5f51ed5a6475929c79d9c89504ab9b5b0f4e8.png

I hope you keep enjoying the game as I build more features to it. The game will be receiving updates monthly until at least the end of the summer, so be on the lookout ːpeaceː

If you want to share your thoughts on how the game can be improved (and possibly be featured next month) please consider joining the discord server. You can also post in the Steam Discussion. I read every comment about the game!
